new_value: Not applicable: the current rust/lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs does not have with_rf_metrics/with_rssi_ema/with_snr_ema float setters — those were part of an earlier API shape that was refactored to integer-typed setters (record_rx takes i8, record_density takes u8, record_load_factor takes u32), all of which are inherently finite.
